correctness.rationale: Comparing gh with hg gives the indicated sign for g⁻¹h⁻¹gh and yields the central coordinate x·y′−x′·y. A complementary unit coordinate realizes any prescribed t and detects any nonzero horizontal vector, so the center and derived subgroup are exactly the stated central copy of R. For fixed nonzero horizontal vector of least coordinate valuation s, the image is precisely (π^s) because one coefficient generates it. Every attainable target has q^((2m−1)n+s) horizontal preimages by the additive fiber theorem. The number of such first vectors is the difference of successive ideal powers q^(2m(n−s))−q^(2m(n−s−1)); the zero first vector contributes q^(2mn) only at zero target. The two freely chosen central coordinates give q^(2n). Combining exponents gives the geometric summand q^(−(2m−1)s) after pulling out the stated prefactor. Every new ideal layer contributes positively, with the displayed target multiplicity, and summing over targets gives q^((4m+2)n). None of these steps assumes equal characteristic or inverts two. Direct independent word enumeration in H_1(Z/4) gave (1408,768,1152,768); m=2 over Z/4 by direct pairing gave (280576,245760,276480,245760). Direct word enumeration in H_1(Z/8) gave 47104 at zero and (24576,36864,43008) in ascending nonzero valuation order, with no noncentral outputs.
residual_risks: Finite cases corroborate but do not certify all rings. The uniform-law argument uses commutative chain-ring ideals; other rings need not have these image strata.

value.rationale: The fibers of the commutator map are a natural invariant of this class-two group family. The complete labeled-by-valuation distribution, including multiplicities, provides more information than the commuting probability and specifies exactly what cannot distinguish nonisomorphic chain rings with the same parameters by this invariant. The uniform law also gives unbounded spectra within a single natural family rather than just existence of examples.
residual_risks: Does not classify groups by the invariant or treat other word maps.
